entries.4e65e925591351ef: A business that plans, develops, manufactures and sells toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and food, apparel, household goods, plastic models, prizes, stationery and other products, and is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers in the group. Consolidated subsidiaries in this segment under 'Status of Affiliated Companies' include Bandai Co., Ltd., BANDAI SPIRITS Co., Ltd., Megahouse Corporation and Sunstar Stationery Co., Ltd., and the equity-method affiliate Tsuburaya Productions Co., Ltd. also falls under this segment. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥646,180 million (up 12.4% year on year). Products aimed at high-target (adult) customers, such as Gunpla (Gundam series plastic models), collector's figures and Ichiban Kuji (character lotteries), performed well, driven by stronger sales and marketing and product lineups. Cards such as trading card games, Gashapon (capsule toys), and confectionery and food also contributed to performance through broader product lineups, target segments and areas of expansion, and stronger touchpoints with customers. New products such as 'Tamagotchi Paradise' and other Tamagotchi-related products became popular in Japan and overseas, and stationery such as sticker products was also a hit. The company explains that it was partly affected by tariffs, mainly in the interim consolidated accounting period.

entries.672cf08a365dade4: A business that plans, produces and operates animated video and music content, manages and operates copyrights and publishing rights, scouts and develops artists, and conducts live entertainment business (former name: 'IP Production Business'). Consolidated subsidiaries in this segment under 'Status of Affiliated Companies' include Bandai Namco Filmworks Inc., Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. and Sotsu Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥73,251 million (down 3.1% year on year), and revenue including intra-group sales was ¥95,506 million (up 5.3% year on year). The new Gundam series video work 'Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX' attracted new fan groups in addition to existing fans, and theatrical box office revenue, global video streaming and product and service licensing contributed to performance. The theatrical work 'Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway's Flash Kiss of the Witch', which began screening in the fourth quarter of the consolidated accounting period, also had a strong start. Through theatrical works, music and live events, 'Love Live!' series became popular, while the global expansion and video streaming of existing Gundam series and 'One Punch Man' remained stable.

entries.a479f40a9540604c: The company cites its 'IP-axis strategy' as the group's strength. This strategy seeks to maximize the value of IP by leveraging the worldview and characteristics of IP and delivering it as the optimal products and services, to the optimal regions at the optimal timing, and is advanced through collaboration among the businesses. The company also states that it emphasizes portfolio balance across diverse IP, a broad range of business categories and regions, and will strengthen a stable earnings base. It also states that the group's greatest asset and strength are its group employees.

entries.b908c323934f7abf: Under the group's highest-level concept, its purpose 'Fun for All into the Future', and its medium- to long-term vision 'Connect with Fans', it is advancing a three-year medium-term plan starting from April 2025. The company states that it has set three common themes (including 'further expansion of business scale' and 'acquisition of new business pillars') and four key themes ('Making great things', 'Expanding further', 'Nurturing continuously' and 'Deepening refinement'), and that it will further strengthen its 'IP-axis strategy', which maximizes the value of IP, in global markets. The priority regions are North America and mainland China. Growth investment of approximately ¥600 billion is planned during the medium-term plan period, and the numerical target for the fiscal year ending March 2028 is consolidated revenue of ¥1.45 trillion (announced February 2025).

Consolidated subsidiaries listed under this segment in [Status of Affiliated Companies] include Bandai Namco Experience Inc., Bandai Namco Amusement Inc. and Hanayashiki Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥151,759 million (up 13.0% from the previous fiscal year). Same-store sales at domestic amusement facilities were 107.0% of the same period of the previous year. In particular, facilities linked with the group's products and services, such as "Bandai Namco Cross Store", "Gashapon Department Store" and experience-type official IP shops, as well as activity facilities, performed well. In sales of arcade games, "Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Vs. 2 Infinite Boost" performed well. The company states that, in addition to expanding facilities that draw on its unique strengths, it will strengthen their role as points of contact with fans to spread awareness of the group's products and services.
